decision.reason: The original exercise computes the first strictly greater value to the right for every input position. Source 496 adds only selecting those results for a unique-value subset in query order: zip nums2 to its complete next-greater output, then look up nums1. Its unique 0..10000 inputs are covered by the original arbitrary-integer contract. The mapping takes O(n+m) total time with the original stack; preserve its existing progress ID.

adaptation: value-to-result map followed by query-order projection
